title: Labosardach
summary: Raleigh names Labosardach in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Labosardach, also printed Labassardach and Laborosoardoch, the sonne of Niglisar, slaine at the end of nine moneths. He was not equated with Lab-Assar Dach, and Scaliger his calling Belsazer by this name was not a merge. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
